title: Oozing Argentinian Dulce de Leche Empanadas
description: Sour, tender, nostalgic Argentinian empanadas featuring a rich, caramelized dulce de leche filling. Perfect for dessert or snack time.
instructions: Combine flour, lard or shortening, and salt in a mixing bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a pressure cooker to 15 psi.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk using a rolling pin.
Place a tablespoon of dulce de leche in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges together to seal the empanada.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Place the empanadas in the pressure cooker and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the pressure cooker and let them cool for 5 minutes.
